title: [Bug]: [DE] XRechnung/ZUGFeRD — no posting-time error when SELLER CONTACT (BG-6) source data is incomplete, producing non-compliant e-invoices
summary: E-Document posting now validates that seller contact information (from salesperson or company data) is complete before generating XRechnung/ZUGFeRD e-invoices, preventing non-compliant XML that would fail validation.
key_points: New mandatory check for seller contact fields (name, phone, email) during e-document posting
Validation mirrors the export logic by checking salesperson first, then falling back to company information
Error messages identify which field is missing and from which source it was expected
Applies to both XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats with dedicated test coverage for each
Existing documents with incomplete contact data will now fail to post
